summary: Ecopetrol S.A., a Colombian state-controlled oil and gas company, furnished a Form 6-K with its first-half 2026 earnings release. The filing reports strong quarterly results, including revenue of COP 40.2 trillion, EBITDA of COP 17.7 trillion, and record refining throughput, while noting dividends of COP 5.0 trillion paid and a 2.0x gross debt-to-EBITDA ratio. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action was described. The document is a routine earnings update under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation. It discloses no deal terms, advisory roles, or structural changes, and there is no risk-arbitrage angle.
